title: Maximum Number of Vowels in a Substring of Given Length
summary: For a string s and integer k, determine the highest count of vowel characters in any substring of s that is exactly k characters long.
statement: For a string s and integer k, determine the highest count of vowel characters in any substring of s that is exactly k characters long. Vowels are 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', and 'u'.
constraints: Count lowercase vowels a,e,i,o,u in every length-k substring.
hints: Count vowels in the initial length-k window.
Slide one character at a time, adding the entrant and subtracting the character k positions behind.
Every length-k substring appears once as the maintained window.
editorial: Every length-k substring appears once as the maintained window.

tests.explanation: The substring iii contains three vowels.
Every adjacent pair contains two vowels.
